title: Logs
subtitle: What happened on this computer, newest first.
lk.empty: Entries come from your programs, Bots and scripts.
act.explainEmpty: This view has no lines to explain.
key.strip: Show or hide the problems strip
done.capped: This page lists the newest {{n}} runs of a range, so older runs are not in the file. Pick a shorter range to export them.
done.complete: Everything in this range is in the file.
done.loaded: The file holds what this page had loaded. Show older rows first to include more.
done.notKept: The computer keeps about {{span}} of activity. Anything older was not in the file.
done.partial: Some of this range could not be read. The file says where it stops.
done.program: The file holds the program's recent output. It may be incomplete and has no times.
done.pruned: Older activity in this range had already been removed to make room, so the file may start late.
done.removed: Some activity was removed while the export ran, so the file has a gap.
ex.all: All visits, Bot calls and changes in this time range
ex.failed: The export did not finish. Try again.
ex.size: Up to 8,000 rows or 8 MB. Recognized passwords, keys and tokens are removed; check the file before sharing it.
ex.sizeProgram: The program's last 10,000 lines. Recognized passwords, keys and tokens are removed; check the file before sharing it.
ex.tooBig: This program's output is too large to export.
ex.title: Export logs
explain.againNote: Sends a new request and may use more of your AI helper's budget.
explain.answer.label: Your AI helper's answer
explain.choose: That model can't be used here. Choose another.
explain.cost.price: Uses your account: at most about {{amount}} at list price.
explain.cost.underCent: Uses your account: less than $0.01 at list price.
explain.cost.unknown: Uses your account. The price isn't listed.
explain.exactly: Your AI helper will read exactly this
explain.fewer.entries: To keep it short, only the newest {{n}} of {{total}} entries are included.
explain.fewer.output: To keep it short, only the last {{n}} of {{total}} lines are included.
explain.framed: Open the Hub in its own tab to ask your AI helper.
explain.judge.consent: We can't tell if {{model}} runs on {{computer}} right now. Nothing was sent.
explain.judge.gone: {{computer}} no longer lists {{model}}. Choose another model. Nothing was sent.
explain.judge.scope: The computer changed. Choose the model again. Nothing was sent.
explain.judge.setup: {{model}} needs setting up first. Nothing was sent.
explain.judge.unread: Checking which models are ready. Try again in a moment.
explain.model.failed: The list of models couldn't be loaded right now.
explain.model.unknown: This model may need a key or setup first
explain.on: Asks your chosen model about this text. On {{name}}.
explain.out.busy: Your AI helper is busy. Try again in a moment.
explain.out.declined: Your AI helper declined to answer this.
explain.out.empty: Your AI helper sent back an empty answer.
explain.out.lost: No answer came back. Your AI helper may still have used some of its budget.
explain.out.notSent: This couldn't be sent. Nothing was used.
explain.out.old: Your computer's AI helper needs an update for this.
explain.out.refused: Your AI helper couldn't take this request.
explain.pick.label: Models
explain.pick.note: To add more models, open the Agent app on this computer.
explain.scrubbed: Recognized secrets are hidden as [REDACTED]. Check the text before sending.
explain.title: Explain with your AI helper
g.sample: Based on the newest {{read}} of {{total}} problems.
g.title: What keeps going wrong
lbl.scripts_need_update: Per-script logs need the next Scripts update
live.asOf: Showing what was there at {{time}}. The computer's logs are no longer open to the Hub.
live.held: New activity is waiting above what you are reading.
live.hidden: Live paused while this tab was in the background.
live.on: Live: new activity appears at the top.
live.overflow: 1,000 or more new rows arrived. Some in between may not be shown.
live.partial: Live: new activity that matches your filters appears at the top.
live.paused: Live paused: the computer stopped answering.
live.reset: The computer's record was cleared here.
prog.asOf: Recent output as of {{time}}. Refresh to read it again.
prog.empty: This program has written nothing here yet.
prog.notTimed: The Hub adds no times to program output; a program may print its own. Output is not kept forever: this is what the program wrote most recently.
prog.title: Program output
prog.tooBig: This program's output is too large to show here. Export it instead.
row.bigWhy: This entry is too large to show in full. Its time and outcome are kept; Export includes what can be shown.
row.outErr: The recent output could not be read.
sc.pick: Pick a script in Scripts to see its runs here.
prog.gone: That program is not on this computer any more. Pick one below.
spike: Problems jumped around {{time}} ({{n}} in a short span).
st.blocked: The Hub could not reach this computer's logs.
st.blockedWhy: The computer is running, but its logs did not answer the Hub. Its access rules may not allow it. The Agent on the computer can still show them.
st.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches {{when}}. Try a wider time range or fewer filters.
st.failed: These logs could not be read.
st.failedSome: Some of these logs could not be read.
st.noList: Your computers could not be listed. Reload the page to try again.
st.noPrograms: No programs run on this computer yet.
st.offline: You are offline. Try again when the connection is back.
st.partChanges: Changes could not be read, so this list shows other activity only.
st.pick: Pick a computer to see its logs.
st.restShown: The rows below are what could be read.
st.privateWhy: Only its owner's own tools can read them. The Agent on the computer can still show them.
st.quota: This computer has read its logs a lot recently. Try again in a while.
st.rate: Too many reads at once. Try again in a moment.
st.servedOnly: Visits, Bots and proxy decisions open in your Hoody Hub online.
st.servedOnlyWhy: A Hub opened from a file on this device cannot read them. Changes, scripts, programs and account activity work here.
st.skipChanges: Changes are not shown while a filter or search is on.
st.stopped: This computer is stopped. Start it, then open its logs.
st.tooLarge: Some activity is too large to show here. Export includes what can be shown.
st.tooLong: That search is too long. Use 200 characters or fewer.
st.unavailable: The computer's logs are busy or restarting. Try again in a moment.
st.update: This computer needs an update before the Hub can show its logs. The Guide shows how to update it.
st.updateSome: This computer needs an update before the Hub can show all of its logs. The Guide shows how to update it.
stop.quota: the computer has read its logs a lot recently.
stop.tooLarge: some activity was too large to read.
sum.errSome: Only part of these logs could be read.
v.notKept: This browser would not keep the view, so nothing was saved.
v.clearFail: This browser would not remove the saved views. They are still there.
v.clearAskBody: They are saved in this browser only. Once removed, they can't be brought back.
v.copyDesc: It opens these logs for anyone who already has access to this computer.
v.name: Name
v.saveHolds: Keeps the source, Result, When and the program or script. The search, output channel, port and Around a moment are not kept.
comp.failed: The computer list could not be read.
